name: (m)ORPH Mixed
summary:
**(m)ORPH Mixed** is a mixed reality VR-Music experience created by audio technologist Kasson Crooker. The original Morph VR-Music app was released in 2021 and this brand new version focuses on an immersive, mixed reality experience.

(m)ORPH is not a game, but lets players interact with spatial audio in real-time to create a dynamically evolving music environment. Immersive sound objects and abstract, audio-reactive visuals are all around your room, yielding an 360-degree experience that you get to control
